(1) the cellular basis for antigen-specific leukocyte adherence inhibition in a murine tumor model is a monocyte that is programmed to undergo adherence inhibition by sensitized B lymphocytes; (2) this programming is mediated by a B cell surface immunoglobulin; and (3) this programmed monocyte is a nonspecific cytotoxic cell.
